Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values

Class MandelaClass

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values.MandelaClass
All Implemented Interfaces:
Callable
public final class MandelaClass extends Object implements Callable
A declared type: the runtime object behind class, type and enum.

All three share one representation because the machine treats them the same way — a name, an optional base, a set of methods, and a rule for making values:

  • MandelaClass.Kind.CLASS — mutable instances, identity equality, inheritance, field initialisers and init blocks.
  • MandelaClass.Kind.TYPE — a value record. Construction is positional or by name, equality is structural, and there is no inheritance.
  • MandelaClass.Kind.ENUM — a closed set of constants, created once when the declaration runs and reachable only as Name.CONSTANT; equality is identity by construction.

A class is also Callable: Point(1, 2) is a call, so the compiler emits the same instruction for constructing a value as for invoking a function, and the VM branches on the callee's kind.
